annotations.title: EVE Frontier Constellation Sovereignty & Multi-Node Fuel Radar

description: Monitors constellation-wide Lagrange Network Node fuel reserves, identifies the weakest sovereignty node, and calculates logistics convoy resupply urgency. Use when auditing multi-system sovereignty fuel health across an entire tribe constellation; for optimizing gigajoule load on a single individual Lagrange Network Node, use optimize_eve_node_power instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'constellation_id' ('alert_threshold_hours' defaults to '24h'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (30 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

alert_threshold_hours.description: Minimum remaining fuel horizon before triggering convoy dispatch; defaults to '36h' when omitted.

constellation_id.description: Constellation or solar system cluster identifier (e.g. 'Frontier-Delta-09').

name: monitor_eve_constellation_fuel

sovereignty_health_index.description: Normalized sovereignty stability score from 0.0 to 1.0.

weakest_node_id.description: Identifier of the Network Node closest to fuel exhaustion.

title: EVE Frontier Constellation Sovereignty & Multi-Node Fuel Radar
